messages:
emma: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a compact rollout metadata tweak to help safe client fallbacks. Idea: add a lightweight `compatibility_matrix` + `downgrade_policy` and an optional `stability_score` so routers/clients can make deterministic fallback choices without hitting control-plane every request.

emma: Sketch (very rough):
```json
{
  "compatibility_matrix": {
    "model-v2": {
      "compatible_with": ["model-v1", "model-v1-quant"],
      "incompatibilities": ["embedding-format-change"],
      "notes": "tokenizer bump; ok for text-gen but embeddings differ"
    }
  },
  "downgrade_policy": {
    "on_latency_spike": "prefer_compatible_variant",
    "on_quality_regression": "roll_to_previous_stable"
  },
  "stability_score": 0.87,
  "eval_suite_id": "eval-2026-03-15-emoji"
}
```

raj: I like the idea. Two quick questions: 1) storage overhead if we store full matrices on every model object? 2) clients will need to understand semantics — do we version the schema (compat_v1)?

mina: +1 to versioning. Also, be careful: some clients (mobile/edge) won't be able to read a big matrix. Suggest default "best_effort" semantics: if client doesn't understand, control-plane still routes, but metadata gives hints for advanced routers.

oliver: We should add per-variant weight-aware entries. For multi-variant canaries we need something like:
```
"compatibility_matrix": {
  "canary-v2-a": {
    "compatible_with": ["stable-v1"],
    "min_confidence": 0.92
  }
}
```
That allows runtime to prefer a stable when confidence < min_confidence.

mina: Also we need to tie eval_suite_id -> telemetry so regressions are attributable. If rollout metadata references evals we can auto-trigger alerts when quality drops.

raj: Implementation idea: store the matrix as a small proto reference + optional inline payload when necessary. That keeps DB rows compact but lets us ship full details in the model manifest when required.

emma: Good call. Proposed minimal MVP:
- add `compat_v1` small schema (enum + optional inline small list)
- `downgrade_policy` with 3 named strategies (prefer_compatible_variant, force_rollback, allow_degraded)
- `stability_score` (0..1) + optional `eval_suite_id`
Action: I'll open RFC follow-up PR with the tiny schema and a migration plan for existing manifests.

oliver: One more nit: name `downgrade_policy` maybe confusing. What about `fallback_strategy`? clearer?

emma: @oliver good point — i prefer `fallback_strategy`. I'll rename in the PR.

deploy-bot: :information_source: canary deployment started at 1785012400: model=canary-v2-a target=prod-traffic 5%

emma: Thanks — action items: 1) PR + tests (emma), 2) skylab infra changes to accept compat_v1 (raj), 3) console UX for stability_score & eval link (mina/oliver). Will assign in the PR.

oliver: sounds good. i'll mock up a tiny console wireframe showing stability + eval link tomorrow. :+1:

mina: i'll add telemetry hooks to tie eval_suite_id -> alerting.

raj: i'll prototype proto reference storage + DB migration script.

emma: cool — thanks everyone. Closing here unless objections.
